_doc: Per-device box attributes. include: the reader needs four sides named top, right, bottom, left. exclude: it does not (reason given). Derived from the framework DB (block_attributes rows with tier_shape box_only, or tier_object with a box_family) and the readers; scripts/tests/test_box_string_rules.py fails when a row is unclassified. Where block.json declares the attribute with a non-object type the rule skips it.
